---
name: analyze-bug
description: Analyze a defect report and determine likely cause, severity, priority and additional tests.
agent: qa-bug-agent

Analyze the provided bug information.

Return:
- Bug summary
- Reproduction understanding
- Expected vs actual
- Severity with justification
- Priority with justification
- Evidence
- Possible root causes
- Areas to investigate
- Additional test scenarios
- Regression recommendations

Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses.
